chapter: Billie Holiday with the band (1971 session)
title: Whether Billie was fired for refusing to sing the blues
summary: Kuehl relays Jo Jones's claim that Hammond fired Billie over the blues; Basie denies it and says she was a stylist, not a blues singer.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her
